items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I had a chance to work with Kathleen on her latest... I played on it

ctx.x: You’ve got some good looking things in your future I see, playing with some notable people coming up?

I hope so. Yeah, well actually I’ll be touring with Chick Corea this summer. He’s putting together a tribute to Bud Powell. We’re going to go out with a group and we’re going to play pretty much all Bud Powell music. And the band consists of myself, Roy Haynes is playing drums, Wallace Roney is playing trumpet, Joshua Redman is going to do most of the tour, but Kenny Garrett is going to play saxophone on a few concerts. So I’m really looking forward to playing with Chick this summer. Oh, that’s going to be a…
Quite a schedule. Do you have any time to practice?
